snippet.title: Speed Dates - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you afraid of going out and meeting new people? Fear not as you no longer need to exit your house to experience the sheer awkwardness and stupidity of the whole dating situation. 

Speed dates is a perfect game for the ones who value movie-like experiences. Meet 18 attractive women with their own troubles and stories... Use all the charm you’ve got to conquer their hearts in this FMV. Now on every major platform!
